name: hep_static_ref_1015
structural_change: v15 successor of the retired flat hfd_lk_ep (13 failed routes): one ~8k-flop master for all 9 ep windows, lane gearbox 613b->512b fixed 4-in-5 format + off-die elastic RX pingpong (0az boundary), every port pin-registered, one clock root. Route-2 fix of route-1 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD (setup/hold conflict at enable-mux D pins with one 612-load select): selects replicated per 64-b slice, bypass-free SRAM leaf, macro columns facing one centre datapath channel, logic band at the COLL/SerDes faces. Route-3 fix of route-2 EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION (12 zero-capacity M2/M4 gcells on 3 nets at the inward SRAM faces of the 47 um centre channel; abutted N-S macro pairs left no horizontal corridor): the two macro rows are separated by a 21.6 um horizontal channel (outline 434.72 x 315.36 inside the 434.72 x 515.2 window), giving the face escapes and the band->channel nets a crossing corridor.

job.purpose: HBM v15 link endpoint master (ep_N0..N3/ep_S0..S4): static lane gearbox + 0az off-die elastic RX boundary; replaces hfd_lk_ep v14

slot_change_request.reason: route 1 (b58969306) EARLY_FAIL_HOLD at FF -79 ps on u_block.pin_flit[484]/D: setup/hold conflict at a 2:1 enable-mux D pin (select vp[2] = one flop fanning out to 612 flops, SS setup +62 ps; data leg dout->pin_flit needs >= +109 ps FF). Route 2: (RTL) every wide select replicated per 64-b slice (block pin_flit, pingpong merge, TX beat idle), SRAM leaf without the never-firing write->read bypass; (floorplan) two abutted N-S macro columns in the upper part, left column MY / right R0 so all rd_out / wd_in[265:0] / clk faces face one 47.3 um centre channel (M3+M5 2,300 vertical tracks for 1,224 crossing bits = 0.53) (bits 0..305 left half, 306..611 right half), outer 20.3 um edge channels for wd_in[305:266] + ties, lower 114 um band for the gearboxes and pin registers (SerDes W pins 2..140 um, COLL S face, clk S centre). Outline 434.72 x 293.76 inside the 434.72 x 515.2 ep window.

pin_regs.reason: hfd_ep_static registers every input and every output at its pin in RTL (hfd_ep_static.sv: p_* input pin registers for tx_v/tx_frame/rx_* controls/sd_rx/sd_st; sd_tx = the TX beat register; rx_pin_v/rx_pin_flit = the pingpong merge registers; rx_block_ready/phy_up/fault/fault_cause output registers); a recipe-3 wrapper would add a second +1-cycle stage on 2,450 pins
